jobs.prompt:
Delta review of the 1.167.27 hotfix for Project Swarm. Round 1 (coordination/review/guard-identity-review-r1.json in context) failed the train 3 guarded-runner change: tools/concurrency-guard.mjs restoreIfStale acted on marker.childPid even for markers written before boot, so after a reboot a swarm command could SIGTERM an unrelated process, wedge the marker on EPERM, or exit a normal command with code 0 without running it. 1.167.26 shipped only the pre-boot short-circuit. This hotfix completes the blocker fix. The exact code delta against main at 8ba004cf is coordination/review/guard-identity.diff; the full current files are in context.

What this delta changes:
- Same-boot identity: noteChild records BOTH the child's process start time (ps -o lstart=) and its full command line (ps -o command=). restoreIfStale acts on childPid only when both recorded values are non-empty and exactly match the live pid's current values; a missing, unreadable or mismatched start time OR command line means 'not ours' and restores, clears the marker, and signals nothing.
- No silent success: a genuine self-orphan (recorded child, wrapper dead, identity matches) now writes a clear stderr error that the command was NOT run and exits 143 instead of 0; the marker stays for the watcher or the next command. A safe stale marker restores and the command then runs.
- EPERM: an owner or child that is alive only by EPERM belongs to another user, so restore and clear the marker instead of wedging it.
- Kept: pre-boot markers restore directly (no probe/signal/exit); SIGTERM at most once per marker (termSentAt); the watcher still SIGTERMs, waits, SIGKILLs, then restores; in-boot orphan behaviour confirmed earlier.
- Version 1.167.26 -> 1.167.27 and CHANGELOG entry (mechanical).
- Tests: 42 in tests/concurrency-guard.test.mjs, including pre-boot reused pid (no kill, no exit), EPERM owner and child, start-time and command-line mismatches, blank/unreadable identity, self-orphan exits 143 with the marker left, safe stale marker runs, and the real ps identity probe.

Pass bar (owner): confirm the round-1 blocker is CLOSED for each failure case (an innocent process killed; a wedged marker; a normal command exited 0 without running), with line evidence and test names. Find NEW blockers introduced by this delta: a crash or hang on the normal every-command path (restoreIfStale runs at the start of every swarm command), a regression of the pre-boot or in-boot behaviour, the value never restored, a kill of a process that is not ours, or any success exit that hides a guard failure. Everything else is a follow-up.

Write ONLY coordination/review/guard-identity-review.json: {"verdict":"pass"|"fail","score":0-10,"round1":[{"blocker":1,"status":"closed"|"open","evidence":""}],"blockers":[{"file":"","line":0,"problem":"","exploit_or_failure":"","fix":""}],"followups":[same shape],"summary":""}. verdict is fail if a round-1 blocker is open or blockers is non-empty.
